Name: Backwoods Shortcut
Author: IndiePhunq
Description:
If Stardew Valley Expanded taught me anything, it's just how convenient a backwoods shortcut is. I don't always play with SVE, though, so I made a standalone shortcut.

To install, you'll need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]. Like any other mod, drop this content pack into your Mods folder. On an existing save, there will be a large bush you'll need to navigate around. To fix the bush, you can install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2269?tab=files]Entoarox Framework[/url] and type [code]world_bushreset[/code] into the SMAPI console.

Manifest.Name: Backwoods Shortcut
Manifest.Description: The backwoods map now has a shortcut from the path to the road.
